Cross-page evidence for formation of 12a/13a/13b, dihydroxylation to 14, MOM protection to 15, and elaboration to 16/17. The 86% value for 13b is explicitly overall over two steps and is not substituted for the 87% RCM step yield drawn on page 3.

regions.finding: Four arrows were separated: ligand-controlled Pd couplings to 12a/12b and RCM steps to 13a/13b. The 99%, 79%, 87%, and selectivity annotations were associated with their depicted products.
Five operations were separated: 13a to 14, 14 to 15, debenzylation of 15 to an unnumbered alcohol, carbamate formation to 16, and oxidative cyclization to 17.
Five experiments were retained: protected-substrate 18 trace-adduct test, two ligand-controlled 20 + 19 coupling/RCM runs, 21a benzoylation to 22, and 21a dihydroxylation to 23.
